papers.title: Hierarchy of Rényi Coherent Information in Stabilizer Codes
papers.abstract: Rényi coherent information, a computable proxy for the von Neumann coherent information, is widely used to study mixed-state phases of matter and decodability transitions in noisy quantum error-correcting codes. However, being a difference of two Rényi entropies, it need not be monotonic in the Rényi index, and lacks the operational meaning of its von Neumann counterpart. papers.title: Effective Ionic Valence and Local Magnetic Moment in Kagome Superconductors
papers.abstract: In order to understand the unexpected similarity and the correlated behavior in kagome superconductor families AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = K, Rb, Cs) and ATi$_3$Bi$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), we investigate the Hartree-scale local electronic structure of these systems. papers.title: Quantifying Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract:
Quantifying properties of quantum states through the limits of their manipulation is a central goal of quantum resource theories.
